notes: v432 — ⭐ Watch Score 5+ and 6+ join the 🧪 all-scans card, so you can see the whole score ladder (5+ / 6+ / 7+) and where the value actually starts. Also an accuracy fix: the card was measuring accumulation against a baseline that included the very days it was counting, which made a share's own heavy buying raise its own bar — Heavy Accumulation and the Watch Score rows were badly understated (that '6 fires' row). They now use the same before-the-window baseline the app itself uses, so those rows show their true frequency and edge. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
